All four miners are down 12.1% to 14.8% over five days. MARA, last night's only Selling name, dropped off the screen, and nothing on tonight's screen clears the bar.
IV rank is under 7 on 6 of 9 names (52-week CBOE rank). RBLX (58) is the only one paid in the rich half of its range.
SMMT, CLSK, RBLX and AUR have wide quotes. CLSK (113) and AUR (109) also have under 200 OI at the strike.
SMR sits at 1.1% of its 52-week range, 86.5% off the high.
Gamma scan: 14 of 25 names are in positive dealer gamma (pinning), 11 in negative (moves get amplified).
